definitions.explanation: A tree that retains its leaves throughout the year, continuously shedding and replacing them rather than losing them all at once.

examples.japanese: {松|まつ}は{常緑樹|じょうりょくじゅ}なので{冬|ふゆ}も{緑|みどり}です。
examples.english: Pine is an evergreen, so it stays green in winter too.

examples.japanese: {常緑樹|じょうりょくじゅ}は{一年中|いちねんじゅう}{葉|は}があります。
examples.english: Evergreen trees have leaves all year round.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{常緑樹|じょうりょくじゅ}を{植|う}えると{冬|ふゆ}も{寂|さび}しくない。
examples.english: If you plant evergreens in the garden, it won't look bleak in winter.

notes:
{常緑樹|じょうりょくじゅ} - trees that remain green year-round.

{常緑|じょうりょく} = evergreen, {樹|じゅ} = tree

Types:
- {常緑針葉樹|じょうりょくしんようじゅ} - evergreen conifers (pine, cedar)
- {常緑広葉樹|じょうりょくこうようじゅ} - evergreen broadleaf (camellia, tea plant)

Common Japanese evergreens:
- {松|まつ} (pine) - symbol of longevity
- {杉|すぎ} (cedar)
- {椿|つばき} (camellia)
- {椎|しい} (chinquapin)
- {茶|ちゃ} (tea plant)

Opposite: {落葉樹|らくようじゅ} (deciduous trees)
